label: Animation
description: A ready-made animated graphic from make_animation (a .mov with its .anim.json sidecar), laid over the whole frame exactly as rendered: no card, no scaling, no backdrop. If the words run longer than the animation, its last frame holds. Any asset with an animation sidecar is shown this way whatever treatment was asked for.

hold.help: minimum seconds on screen (default: the animation's own length)
